sourceUrlPolicy: Navigation URLs remove query/fragment/credentials/referral path; exact original request and hash are retained in the original offline evidence bundle, not served by this app.

archives.provenance: unchanged copy of prior public evidence archive

runtimeAuditability: All original containers resolve inside the retained evidence archive; no dependence on chat work directory.

publicReplayUrlPolicy.navigationUrl: existing sanitized non-affiliate navigation URL; no query or authentication
publicReplayUrlPolicy.originalRequestUrl: exact retained original HTTP target when safe and actually requested; null plus reason otherwise
publicReplayUrlPolicy.publicReplayUrl: allowlisted public query or original public GitHub permalink; planned requests explicitly marked planned_not_collected
publicReplayUrlPolicy.rejected: credentials, authentication/affiliate query parameters, unknown queries, referral/registration paths and non-public fragments
